ModMetaData.name: RimLLM Framework
ModMetaData.author: 綠菇
ModMetaData.description: RimLLM Framework — A unified LLM interface and core infrastructure framework for RimWorld. This mod provides a stable and flexible foundation for managing API keys, model caching, and provider configuration, so other mods don't have to reinvent the wheel. It enables seamless integration with major LLM services (Gemini, OpenAI, local-compatible endpoints, and more), improving stability and maintainability of in-game LLM calls. Key Features: 1. Multi-Provider Support: Native support for Google Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Grok (xAI), Z.ai, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, NVIDIA, and local-compatible endpoints (OpenAI Compatible — LM Studio, Ollama, etc.). 2. Model Fallback: Refactored into a pure model-level precise fallback chain. Players can configure a primary model and multiple exact fallback models; the framework automatically switches on timeout, rate-limit (429), or connection errors to keep LLM calls uninterrupted. 3. AES-256 Encryption: API keys are stored with AES-256 symmetric encryption to reduce plaintext exposure risk. This is an obfuscation-level protection — it does not prevent same-process attacks via reflection or memory reading. Caller-assembly verification has been removed: it could not stop a hostile in-process mod, and its first-come-wins ModId binding could lock out the legitimate owner at startup. 4. Thread Safety & Scribe Scheduling: All dictionary operations are guarded with locks. RecordLog writes are dispatched back to the Unity main thread via RimLLMDispatcher with a 15-second throttle, preventing crashes or TPS spikes caused by background saves. 5. Reasoning Models & Auto Effort: Native support for DeepSeek-R1, Gemini 2.0/2.5 Thinking, and other reasoning models. The layer automatically extracts reasoning_content and thought blocks, wrapping them uniformly in <think>...</think> tags. 6. Embedding SDK: A public embedding API backed by Google, Ollama, or OpenAI-compatible endpoints, plus a cosine similarity helper, so other mods can build semantic search and clustering on top of the framework. A separate API-free Trigram string-similarity utility is also available for use when no embedding provider is configured. 7. Provider Stats: Each provider settings page shows a request success-rate progress bar and an API-side prompt cache hit-rate chart (supports Gemini Context Caching, etc.). 8. Developer SDK: Everything crossing the boundary is a standard Microsoft.Extensions.AI type (IChatClient, IEmbeddingGenerator) — no bespoke client interface to learn, and no registration step. Includes dynamic streaming control and reflection-based recursive JSON Schema cache warm-up, so other mods can integrate LLM services and build Agent tools quickly and reliably.
